text.to: A hungry shade is drawing near.

text.where: verbs.zil:1578 - death when moving through darkness

text.from:
The grue is a sinister, lurking presence in the dark places of the
earth. Its favorite diet is adventurers, but its insatiable
appetite is tempered by its fear of light. No grue has ever been
seen by the light of day, and few have survived its fearsome jaws
to tell the tale.
text.to:
The shade gathers wherever the last ember has gone cold. It hunts
by sound, but recoils from living flame. Few travelers who hear
its whisper in the dark survive to describe it.

text.from:
There is no grue here, but I'm sure there is at least one lurking
in the darkness nearby. I wouldn't let my light go out if I were
you!
text.to:
There is no shade here, but something is listening from the dark.
I would keep that flame alive if I were you!
